## Base URL

`{{baseUrl}}` defaults to `https://api.core.dealoware.com` (live Core API). Local Development is secondary: set `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:5287` (Newman: `--env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:5287`). Key and token variables stay empty in this file.

Swagger is Development-only (`Program.cs` serves Swagger only when `IsDevelopment()`) and returns 404 in Production by design, so this collection is the HTTP reference.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints accept the Authorization header only (query-string and body tokens are rejected).

- **ApiKey:** `Authorization: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}` or `Authorization: ApiKey {{buyerApiKey}}`. Use ApiKey after register for scripted flows that should not depend on JWT expiry.
- **Bearer:** call `POST /auth/token` with `{ "apiKey": "{{sellerApiKey}}" }`, then `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. The token test script stores `accessToken`. Use Bearer when you already minted a JWT (`expiresIn` seconds).

## Rate limits

POST /auth/register and POST /auth/token are fixed-window rate limited per client IP (see RateLimiting in appsettings). A throttled call returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header (whole seconds until the fixed window resets) and JSON body message: "Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header." Wait for Retry-After, then retry. Collection scripts record Retry-After and do not retry in a loop.

Admin routes (`/admin/...`) are out of scope and host-gated to admin.core.

Maker withdraw is not mapped on main. Inbound signed POST is unimplemented. Folders follow the negotiation flow: Auth → Artifact → Negotiation → Offer → Counter → Accept or Decline.

item.name: 06-Accept-or-Decline

exec: pm.test("loginEmail is never included on accept", function () {

request.description: POST /offers/{id}/accept — recipient only. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Response AcceptOfferResponse: id, negotiationId, from/toParticipantId, status, amount, currency, terms, createdAt, identitySealed (false when the Accept grant allows ShareOutbound ContactEmail), includesContactEmail, counterpartyContactEmail (offeror ContactEmail or null if unset), counterpartyDisplayName. loginEmail is never included.
GET /negotiations/{id} after accept. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Response NegotiationResponse with offers[] including the Accepted offer. Contact fields stay on AcceptOfferResponse only.
POST /negotiations/ — new Open negotiation for the decline path. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Response NegotiationResponse; captures negotiationId.
POST /negotiations/{id}/offers — offer the buyer will decline. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Response OfferResponse; captures offerId.
POST /offers/{id}/decline — recipient only. Auth: ApiKey {{buyerApiKey}}. Response OfferResponse with status Declined. Negotiation stays Open.

item.description: Happy path: seller accepts the counter (contact-on-accept). Alternate: fresh negotiation, buyer declines.

item.name: 09-Expiration

request.description: POST /negotiations/ with endsAt in the past. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Response NegotiationResponse 201; captures negotiationId. Expiration is applied on the next mutating or GET party call.
POST /negotiations/{id}/offers after expiration. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Expect 409 `{ error }` mentioning expired.
GET /negotiations/{id} after expiration still returns 200 for a party. Auth: ApiKey {{sellerApiKey}}. Response NegotiationResponse status Expired.

item.description: endsAt in the past: mutations 409, GET still works with status Expired.

item.name: 11-Optional-Rotate-and-Revoke

request.description: POST /auth/register — dedicated participant for rotate/revoke. No Authorization. Response RegisterResponse; captures authDemoApiKey and authDemoSub.

POST /auth/rotate-key — revoke the current API key from Authorization and issue a new one. Auth: ApiKey {{authDemoApiKey}}. Response RotateKeyResponse: apiKey, apiKeyPrefix, revokedKeyPrefix. Captures the new authDemoApiKey.
POST /auth/revoke — revoke the rotated key. Auth: ApiKey {{authDemoApiKey}}. Body RevokeRequest.apiKey (TokenJti alternative not used here). 204 No Content.

item.description: Optional credential hygiene on a dedicated participant so seller/buyer keys stay valid. Skip if you only need the negotiation flow.
